title: Pear with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8f06a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#8fd43a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5fae1e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='top' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e050'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6fb82a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stem' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b57a3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a4a1a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf' x1='0' y1='1' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#3fa82a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7dd45a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow under pear -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#2a5a12' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- pear body -->
  <path d='M50 28 C36 28 33 40 35 50 C37 60 30 68 34 78 C38 88 44 90 50 90 C56 90 62 88 66 78 C70 68 63 60 65 50 C67 40 64 28 50 28 Z' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- lighter highlight on left -->
  <path d='M42 36 C38 42 37 50 39 58 C40 62 41 66 40 70 C38 74 37 78 39 82 C41 86 44 87 46 86 C43 84 41 80 42 76 C43 72 45 68 45 62 C45 54 44 46 46 38 C47 34 45 33 42 36 Z' fill='#d8f79a' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f78a9e' opacity='0.65'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f78a9e' opacity='0.65'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2d1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='52' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2d1a0a'/>
  <ellipse cx='43.5' cy='50' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='59.5' cy='50' rx='1.8' ry='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q50 72 58 62' fill='none' stroke='#2d1a0a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 28 C49 22 50 16 52 12' fill='none' stroke='url(#stem)' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M52 14 C58 8 68 8 72 14 C66 18 58 18 52 14 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <path d='M52 14 C58 13 66 13 71 14' fill='none' stroke='#2f8a1e' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
